Vaanathai Parthen Sad Version Video Song from Manithan Tamil Movie on AP International. Manithan Tamil Movie ft. Rajinikanth and Rubini. Music by Chandrabose, directed by SP Muthuraman and Produced by M. Saravanan and M. Balasubramaniam.
Manithan also stars Raghuvaran, Sridivya, Jai Ganesh, Madhuri, Vinu Chakravarthy, Cho Ramaswamy, Senthil, G. Seenivasa, and Delhi Ganesh among others.
Song: Vanaththai Parthen Sad version
Singers: SP Balasubrahmaniam, Vanitha, and Kovai Murali
Lyrics: Vairamuthu
Enjoy & stay connected with us!
